end.summary:
- Practised choosing exact or approximate values in real-life situations.
- Identified exact counting for drawing boxes and competition participants.
- Identified approximate counting for a changing fair crowd.
- Rounded 3,26,400 to 3,00,000 and worked through rounding to the nearest crore.
- Chops off digits instead of rounding; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised when exact values are needed and when approximate values are suitable, then rounded numbers to the nearest lakh and crore. Ayaan explained their choices using the situation and place values, and corrected the nearest-crore result to 9,00,00,000. One mix-up remained: they treated rounding as dropping digits, so at home, practise checking the next digit before deciding whether to keep or increase the target place.
